outputRows.displayNameZh: 114年度電力-公用售電業電力排碳係數
outputRows.source: 經濟部能源署
outputRows.techDescZh: 適用範圍：檢視公用售電業整體銷售電量之平均電力排碳情形，作為電業管制機關進行管理之依據。
outputRows.techDescEn: Scope of Application: Used to assess the average carbon emissions associated with the total electricity sold by untilities, and to serve as a basis for management by the electricity regulatory authority.
outputRows.notes: 適用於檢視公用售電業整體銷售電量之平均電力排碳情形。

outputRows.displayNameZh: 114年度電力-產業電力排碳係數
outputRows.source: 經濟部能源署
outputRows.techDescZh: 考量產業購買較多綠電，故114年劃分產業盤查使用之電力排碳係數為0.466公斤CO2e/度，適用對象為電價種類中之表燈營業、低壓電力、高壓電力、特高壓電力用戶。
outputRows.techDescEn: Considering that industrial users purchase a higher proportion of green electricity, the electricity carbon emission factor for industrial greenhouse gas inventories in 2025 is set at 0.466 kg CO2e/kWh. This factor applies to users under the following electricity tariff categories: commercial lighting, low-voltage power, high-voltage power, and extra-high-voltage power.
outputRows.notes: 適用表燈營業、低壓電力、高壓電力、特高壓電力用戶。

outputRows.displayNameZh: 114年度電力-民生住宅電力排碳係數
outputRows.source: 經濟部能源署
outputRows.techDescZh: 電價種類為表燈非營業、包燈用戶適用之電力排碳係數為0.471公斤CO2e/度。
outputRows.techDescEn: The electricity carbon emission factor applicable to users under the non-commercial lighting and flat-rate lighting tariff categories is 0.471 kg CO2e/kWh.
outputRows.notes: 適用表燈非營業、包燈用戶。
